summary: A crowd-pleaser on target: a casual player finds about 8 before famous sequels just outside the top 10 use up their lives. The old fixes hold; two small reveal and alias fixes can wait for the next rebuild.
reasons: Casual found 8 in 14 guesses, then lost every life on near misses that each show a gross: Toy Story 4 (#11), Moana 2 (#13), Shrek 2 (#23), Finding Nemo (#21), Toy Story 3 (#12). Ne Zha 2 at #1 and Toy Story 5 at #10 are the reveals. Fan found 9.

Old fixes hold: the two Lion Kings are separate ('lion king' offers the 2019 film to confirm, 'lion king 1994' is #20), 'super mario brothers' and 'mario brothers' count, and 'spiderman' and 'cars' now only offer Across the Spider-Verse and Cars 2 to confirm, free to decline.
Left for the rebuild: unranked misses (Aladdin, Beauty and the Beast, Lilo & Stitch, Cars 2) show no figure though the page has one, and 'frozen two' reads as Frozen. Blitz is deep: 24 of 30 scored.
fixes: scripts/topics.ts (animated-films): `also: [{ tables: [1, 2, 3], name: "Title" }]` has no value, so all 89 unranked answers miss with no figure and score nothing in Blitz, though each table has a 'Worldwide gross' column in the list's unit (table 1: Cars 2 $559,853,036, Puss in Boots $554,987,477; table 2: Coraline $185,860,104; table 3: Aladdin $504,050,219, Beauty and the Beast $438,656,843, Spirited Away $395,802,070, Lilo & Stitch $273,144,151). Add `value: "Worldwide gross"`.

Sequel number words: 'frozen two' offers Frozen (#7) to confirm, and says 'already found' once Frozen is in, so it never reaches Frozen II (#5). 'inside out two', 'incredibles two', 'moana two' and 'ne zha two' offer the first film (a life if confirmed), and 'toy story four' and 'toy story three' aren't recognized. Only 'Zootopia Two' and 'Toy story five' work, through redirects. Add number-word aliases for a trailing 2-9 or II-IX in the pipeline, or have the matcher read a trailing number word as its digit (src/game, coordinator's call).
Add 'Minions 2' as an alias of Minions: The Rise of Gru (#22). Now it offers Minions (#9) to confirm.
